data.one_liner: An animated circular progress bar widget with customizable style and text inside.
data.what_it_does: Provides a CircleProgressBar widget that renders an animated circular progress indicator with customizable foreground and background colors, stroke width, and child widgets displayed inside the circle.
use_when: You need a circular progress indicator with text or custom widgets in the center.
You want a simple animated progress bar with customizable stroke and colors.
avoid_when: You need linear progress bars instead of circular ones.
You require complex chart types like pie charts or gauges.
strengths: Easy to customize style like colors and stroke width.
Supports rendering child widgets like animated counts inside the circle.
weaknesses: Minimal documentation beyond basic usage example.

alternatives.name: percent_indicator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides flexible linear and circular progress indicators with percentage text and custom styling.

data.minimal_example:
CircleProgressBar(
  foregroundColor: Colors.blue,
  backgroundColor: Colors.black12,
  value: 0.5,
  child: AnimatedCount(
    count: 0.5,
    unit: '%',
    duration: Duration(milliseconds: 500),
  ),
)
